# Sven Rosemann — rose-it.dev

## Who

Sven Rosemann is an IT Consultant and Service Owner KI based in Bielefeld, Germany.
He works at Cassini Consulting AG, where he is responsible for building and operating
the company-wide AI platform — from strategic planning to productive deployment.

## What he does

- Designing, building and operating enterprise AI platforms
- Designing AI agents and integrating them into business processes
- Establishing and enforcing AI governance frameworks
- Guiding teams and stakeholders in safe and responsible AI adoption
- Making architectural decisions and owning platform strategy

## Services offered (freelance/consulting)

- KI-Strategie & Roadmap — AI readiness assessments, use case identification, build-vs-buy decisions
- Plattformarchitektur — end-to-end AI platform design on Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search)
- Agenten-Systeme — multi-agent architectures, LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines
- Governance & Compliance — AI governance frameworks, DSGVO, ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz
- Enablement & Training — workshops, best practices, prompt engineering, GitHub Copilot rollout

## Tech stack

Azure AI Foundry · Azure OpenAI · Azure AI Search · Microsoft Fabric ·
GitHub Copilot · Langdock · RAG · Prompt Engineering · Multi-Agent Systems ·
LLM Governance · DSGVO / ISO 27001 · BSI IT-Grundschutz
